weighting: each complete school contributes equal weight; no weighting by captures or fish survival

bootstrap.resampling_unit: whole paired school vectors, shared resampling indices for bothspecies
bootstrap.interpretation: approximate95%familywise coverage for two primary species viaBonferroni; percentile bootstrap withn8 can be unstable; notbiological calibration

secondary_inference: descriptive only; no horizon pooling or independence claim
joint_positive: count schools with strict positive D andG differences; zerosreported separately
historical_data: not pooled with these8 independent freshschools
missing: never fabricate missingcases; report complete-schoolpairs andexplicitpending/failurecounts; primarybootstraponlyafterall8tripletsvalidated
